q: In Colossians, Paul says to set your minds on things where?
why: Christ is seated at God's right hand.
quote: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

q: In Colossians, Paul says forgive as who forgave you?
quote: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

q: In Colossians, what should you put on over all other virtues?
quote: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

q: In Colossians, what are children told to do in everything?
quote: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

q: In Colossians, for whom should you work at whatever you do?
quote: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men

q: In Colossians, what should rule in your hearts?
quote: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts

q: In Colossians, believers rooted in Christ should overflow with what?
why: They are built up in Him.
quote: and overflowing with thankfulness.

q: In Colossians, all things were created through whom?
quote: All things were created through Him and for Him.

q: In Colossians, our speech should be gracious and seasoned with what?
quote: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt

q: In Colossians, what was Luke's job?
quote: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.

q: In Colossians, the Son is the image of whom?
quote: The Son is the image of the invisible God

q: In Colossians, what holds together in Christ?
quote: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.

q: In Colossians, since you received Christ Jesus as Lord, what should you do?
quote: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him

q: In Colossians, God's chosen people should clothe themselves with what?
quote: clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

q: In Colossians, what should richly dwell within you?
quote: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you

q: In Colossians, in whose name should you do everything in word or deed?
why: Give thanks to God through Him.
quote: do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus

q: In Colossians, where does Paul say Christ is seated?
quote: where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

q: To the saints in which city did Paul write Colossians?
quote: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae

q: In Colossians, which church was also to read Paul's letter?
quote: make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans

q: In Colossians, who was always wrestling in prayer for the believers?
quote: He is always wrestling in prayer for you

q: In Colossians, who was sent with Tychicus as a faithful brother?
why: He was one of the Colossians.
quote: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.

q: In Colossians, who would tell the believers all the news about Paul?
quote: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me.
